function.name: weather_forecast_get_prediction
function.description: Fetches the weather prediction for a specified location and date range, including temperature, precipitation chances, and wind speed. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The geographical location for which the weather forecast is requested, in the format of 'City, State' or 'City, Country', such as 'Berkeley, CA' or 'London, UK'.

start_date.description: The start date for the forecast period, in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

end_date.description: The end date for the forecast period, in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

units.description: The unit system used for the weather forecast results.

include_details.description: A flag indicating whether to include detailed forecast information such as hourly data.

### The Top Men’s Underwear Styles (and When to Wear Them) | Style | What it Looks Like | Key Features | Best For | |-------|--------------------|--------------|----------| | **Briefs** | Classic “tight” cut that covers the hips and buttocks fully. | • Full coverage
• Good support
• Usually has a waistband that sits at the natural waist | Everyday casual wear, office, light workouts | | **Boxer Briefs** | Combines the length of boxers with the snugness of briefs. | • Longer leg coverage
• Tight fit for support
• Often has a fly | All‑day comfort, running, gym, travel | | **Boxers** | Loose, long‑legged style that hangs below the waist. | • Breathable, relaxed fit
• Minimal support
• Often has a button fly | Sleep, lounging, hot climates | | **Trunks** | Shorter than boxer briefs, similar shape but with a shorter leg. | • Mid‑rise, snug fit
• Less fabric than boxer briefs
• Good for tight pants | Athletic wear, hot weather, stylish look under fitted jeans | | **Jockstrap / Support Shorts** | Sports‑centric design with a supportive pouch and minimal fabric. | • Excellent support for active use
• Lightweight
• Often has a mesh panel for ventilation | High‑intensity sports, cycling, hiking | | **Compression Briefs** | Very tight, often made from high‑performance fabrics. | • Muscle support
• Moisture‑wicking
• Tighter waistband | Post‑workout recovery, long flights, marathon training | | **Bamboo / Modal** | Made from eco‑friendly fibers. | • Soft, breathable, moisture‑absorbing
• Hypoallergenic | Sensitive skin, eco‑conscious shoppers | | **Microfiber / Performance** | Synthetic blends designed for sweat management. | • Quick‑dry
• Anti‑odor
• Stretchy | Athletes, travelers, people who sweat a lot | --- #### How to Pick the Right One 1. **Consider the Activity** - *Everyday wear*: Boxer briefs or briefs give a good balance of support and comfort. - *Sports*: Compression briefs or jockstraps keep everything in place. - *Travel*: Trunks or compression briefs reduce bulk and stay in place in tight luggage. 2. **Think About Fabric** - *Cotton*: Soft, breathable, but can retain moisture. - *Modal/Bamboo*: Ultra‑soft, great for sensitive skin. - *Performance blends*: Moisture‑wicking, anti‑odor, ideal for sweaty days. 3. **Fit Matters** - A waistband that sits at your natural waist (not too low) prevents bunching. - Look for a “no‑roll” waistband if you’re prone to underwear sliding down. 4. **Style & Fashion** - If you’re wearing tight jeans or a slim suit, trunks or boxer briefs keep the line smooth. - For a more relaxed look, boxers or briefs work well under loose trousers. 5. **Brands Worth Checking Out** - **Calvin Klein** – Classic briefs and boxer briefs. - **Hanes** – Affordable, durable basics. - **Saxx** – Innovative pouch design for support. - **Under Armour** – Performance fabrics for athletes. - **Uniqlo** – Budget-friendly, high‑quality cotton. - **Lululemon** – Premium performance underwear. --- #### Quick Decision Guide | Need | Suggested Style | Why | |------|-----------------|-----| | **Maximum support** | Jockstrap / Compression briefs | Keeps everything in place during intense activity. | | **All‑day comfort** | Boxer briefs | Offers support without being too tight. | | **Breathability** | Boxers | Looser fit allows air circulation. | | **Minimal bulk** | Trunks | Shorter leg reduces bulk in pockets. | | **Sensitive skin** | Bamboo / Modal | Hypoallergenic, soft against skin. | | **Eco‑friendly** | Bamboo / Modal | Sustainable fibers, biodegradable. | --- ### Bottom Line - **For everyday life**: Boxer briefs or briefs are usually the best compromise between support and comfort. - **For sports or travel**: Compression briefs or jockstraps keep everything secure; trunks are great for hot climates. - **For special occasions or sensitive skin**: Choose a softer fabric like bamboo or modal, and consider a style that offers a clean silhouette under tailored clothing. Feel free to mix and match based on your personal preference and lifestyle!
